$comment: THE declaration of omx-chorus, the folder's one hand-written file. Every other file of the folder is generated from it by tools/gen.mjs. Its parameters are by reference to omx-contract's chorus kernel and bind by name to omx-dsp's instance face. Parameter order is append-only.
name: omx chorus
description: The console's chorus: up to four voices read one modulated delay line, the right leg's sweep offset by the spread, mixed with the dry signal.
